heroes.title: Son of Woods
heroes.skills:
Skills

Son of Woods has three listed skills that are unlocked by increasing his level:

Spikes: Gives Spikes X to himself for 2 turns. Ready from the start of the battle. Unlocked from time of purchase (at level 1).
Purify: Silences all enemies. Ready on turn three. Unlocked when Son of Woods reaches level 11.
Wild Rage: +X to all Nature allies for 1 turn. Ready on turn seven. Unlocked when Son of Woods reaches level 21.
	
	
		

Spikes	Purify	Wild Rage		Sudden Death

If a battle takes too many turns, you get an extra skill that deals direct damage to the enemy warlord. Because it is used after Wild Rage, it remains locked as long as Wild Rage is locked. The amount of damage gradually increases as the number of turns increases:

Sudden Death: X direct damage to enemy warlord. Ready on turn eleven and every subsequent turn.
